October 27, 1937. Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Peo and other local newspapers :-

THE AH SUN RADIO STATION CASE : MANAGER EXECUTED

Huang Chu-yin (黄菊隱), Manager of the Ah
Sun Radio Station (亞聲電台), was handed over by the
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau to the Shanghai
Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters on October 11
for embezzling contributions sent in by the public to his
radio station. General Yang Hu, the Martial Law Enforcement
Commander, appointed Judge Chi (奚) of the Military Court
to hear the case.
The investigations were completed yesterday
and it was found that Huang Chu-yin had indeed embezzled
a large sum of contributions. At 1 p.m. yesterday, Huang
was executed near the Chen Chi-mei Memorial Tower at the
West Gate.

Notice Issued by the Martial Law Headquarters

The Martial Law Enforcement Commander's
Headquarters has issued the following notice :-
"With reference to the case in which Huang Chu-
yin of the Ah Sun Radio Station had embezzled a large sum
of money contributed for the relief of wounded soldiers and
refugees, his guilt has been established by this Headquarters.
Huang's action constitutes a menace to national salvation
work.
"The offender was sentenced to death and
executed according to the War Time Military Law of the
Republic of China".

Statement of General Yang Hu

On October 26, General Yang Hu made the following
statement to pressmen :- "At this time when the nation is
engaged in a war of self defence.and the officers and men
at the front are fighting hard, it is the duty of the people
to render them support. The criminal Huang committed
certain acts which constituted a menace to the rear of the
Chinese Army. He was sentenced to death according to the
War Time Military Law as a warning to all undesirable elements.
This severe punishment imposed on Huang will encourage
patriotic people to contribute.
"The Ah Sun Radio Station issued temporary
receipts to persons who paid their contributions to the
station. After reporting the contributions collected
through the station, Huang sent the money (together with
receipts) to the official organization and obtained official
receipts. The station then notified the contributors to
call at the station to change the temporary receipts for
official receipts. This system is good. As only a few
contributors called to exchange for official receipts, Huang
Chu-yin was thus able to embezzle a portion of the contributions
collected. His misconduct was discovered when contributors
called at the radio station for official receipts but could
not get any.
"According to Huang, his station had collected
about $35,000, but the station secured official receipts
from official organizations for $25,000 only. In addition

1937年10月27日。晨间译件。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

亚声电台案：经理被处决

亚声电台（Ah Sun Radio Station）经理黄菊隐（Huang Chu-yin），因侵吞公众向其电台捐赠的捐款，于10月11日被上海市政府警察局移交给上海戒严司令总部。戒严司令杨虎将军指派军事法庭法官奚（Chi）审理此案。
调查已于昨日完成，查明黄菊隐确实侵吞了大量捐款。昨日下午1时，黄在西门陈其美纪念塔附近被处决。

戒严司令部发布的通告

戒严司令总部发布如下通告：
“关于亚声电台黄菊隐侵吞大量用于救济伤兵和难民的捐款一案，本部已认定其罪名成立。黄的行为构成对救国工作的威胁。
“罪犯已被判处死刑，并依据《中华民国战时军律》执行。”

杨虎将军的声明

10月26日，杨虎将军向报界发表如下声明：“值此国家从事自卫战争、前线官兵奋力作战之际，民众有责任给予支持。罪犯黄氏实施了某些构成对中国军队后方威胁的行为。为警示所有不良分子，依据《战时军律》将其判处死刑。对黄氏施以此严惩，将鼓励爱国人士踊跃捐款。
“亚声电台向向该台捐款的人士出具临时收据。在申报通过电台募集的捐款后，黄将款项（连同收据）送交官方机构并取得正式收据。随后，电台通知捐款人前往电台，将临时收据换领正式收据。这一制度本是良好的。由于仅有少数捐款人前来换领正式收据，黄菊隐 thus 得以侵吞部分募集到的捐款。当捐款人前往电台索取正式收据却无法获得时，其不当行为遂被发现。
“据黄称，其电台募集了约35,000元，但电台仅从官方机构获得了25,000元的正式收据。此外

Following the outbreak of the local hostilities, the
Shanghai Actors' Association made arrangements with Mr. Huang
Chu-ying ( 黄 楚 英 ), Manager and Proprietor of the Ah Sung
Radio Station, 359 Rue Amiral Bayle, for the broadcasting on
August 18, 19 and 20 of Peiping style dramas by members of
the Actors' Association for the purpose of soliciting
contributions in aid of the national salvation fund. As a
result of the drive, a total of approximately $30,000 was
obtained, and this sum was handed over to the Shanghai Citizens'
Association situated in the Chung Wai Bank Building, 16 Rue
de la Porte du Nord.
On August 27, 28 and 29, the Ah Sung Radio Station
launched on its own initiative another financial campaign in
the interest of the fund, resulting in the sum of about
$20,000 being obtained, which included gold and silver ware
and jewellery. The names of the contributions and the amounts
of their contributions totalling about $18,000 of the $20,000
collected were published by the Social Evening News in its
issues of August 29, 30 and 31. As no organization had
informed the Shanghai Citizens' Association of the conducting
this drive for funds through the Ah Sung Radio Station,
nor had the Radio Station handed over the contributions, the
Shanghai Citizens' Association became suspicious, and conducted
an investigation, the result of which revealed that the
receipts issued for these contributions were those of the Ah
Sung Radio Station and that the amounts on some of the
receipts issued did not correspond with those on the counterfoils.
The Shanghai Citizens' Association on September 10 notified
the Radio Station Owners' Association, 323 Kiangse Road,

主题 亚声电台经理涉嫌挪用公款。
制作人 侦探督察 潘连璧    转呈人
随着本地战事爆发，上海演艺协会与位于白尔路359号的亚声电台（Ah Sung Radio Station）经理兼业主黄楚英（Huang Chu-ying）先生达成协议，于1937年8月18日、19日和20日广播演艺协会成员演出的北平风格戏剧，旨在为救国基金募集捐款。作为此次运动的结果，共筹集约30,000元，该笔款项已移交至位于北门路16号中外银行大楼内的上海市民协会。
8月27日、28日和29日，亚声电台自行发起另一轮为该基金筹款的运动，结果筹集了约20,000元，其中包括金银器皿和珠宝。在筹集的20,000元中，约18,000元的捐款人姓名及金额刊登在8月29日、30日和31日的《社会晚报》上。由于没有任何组织就通过亚声电台进行此次募捐活动通知上海市民协会，且电台也未移交捐款，上海市民协会产生怀疑，并进行了调查，结果显示这些捐款的收据是亚声电台出具的，且部分出具的收据金额与存根不符。9月10日，上海市民协会通知位于江西路323号的电台业主协会，
（印章：1937年10月12日收讫）
副本已发送。

Consequently Mr. Tu Yueh-sung, Chairman of the Shanghai

but the latter ignored the invitation. Through this
refusal, the Shanghai Various Circles' Committee to Support
Resistance against the Enemy, the Shanghai Citizens'
Association and other public organizations requested the

investigate and they sent an agent to the radio station
with the information that a certain individual living in a
certain house near Langkawan, Zaochow Road, Nantao, desired
to dispose of a large quantity of radio sets and accessories.
The agent insisted that the manager of the radio station
should personally call at the house if he wished to make
the purchase. So at 3 p.m. September 25, a telephone message

call at the house. At 5 p.m. the same day, Mr. Huang Chu-ying,
the manager, accompanied by a fitter and an apprentice,
left his station in a motor car, for the appointment.
Reaching Rue Eugene Bard near Boulevard de Montigny, which
is the boundary of the French Concession, Mr. Huang and
his party left their car (because the vehicle bore no
Shanghai City Government licence) and proceeded on foot to
the place of appointment. Unable to find the house, the
party returned and while passing the rear door of the Chin-

关于此涉嫌挪用公款一事，他们随即检查了收据簿及其他与募捐相关的文件。通过检查，确定某些资金已被挪用。因此，上海市民协会主席杜月笙先生邀请亚声电台经理兼业主黄楚英先生开会，但后者无视了邀请。鉴于此拒绝态度，上海各界抗敌后援会、上海市民协会及其他公共组织于9月24日请求上海市政府警察局进行调查，并派遣一名便衣探员前往电台，告知有一居住在南市枣园路浪卡万（Langkawan，音译）附近某房屋内的人士，欲处置大量收音机及配件。该探员坚持称，如果电台经理希望购买，必须亲自前往该房屋。因此，9月25日下午3时，电台收到电话留言，邀请其经理前往该房屋。当日下午5时，经理黄楚英先生由一名装配工和一名学徒陪同，乘汽车离开电台赴约。到达靠近蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）的欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard，即法租界边界）时，黄及其随行人员下车（因为该车辆未悬挂上海市政府牌照），步行前往约定地点。因未能找到该房屋，一行人返回，在经过枣园路金业公会后门时，突然
